messages:
maria: quick sanity check — running the new Go embed batch+pagination helper against rerank. seeing most vectors at 1536 but ~12 items show length=0 or 1. going to isolate whether it's extractor, streaming retry, or client unmarshal.
jon: ouch. last time that happened was an upstream chunking bug. tokenizer produced empty chunks and extractor returned [] -> embed service emitted empty vector.
maria: our flow: py extractor (v2) -> HTTP POST to embed service -> Go client collects stream and batches. suspect retryable reader may replay and yield truncated object.
kev: what's the Embed response shape you decode? paste minimal snippet.
maria: snippet:
```
reqs := []*EmbedReq{...}
resp, err := client.BatchEmbeddings(ctx, reqs)
// resp.Embeddings[i].Vector length varies: 1536 or 0
```
jon: two quick diagnostics: enable debug json logging on client decode to see raw bytes, and grep server logs for status codes for those IDs. Go json.Decoder may set a slice to nil on decode error.
tara: FYI python extractor used to emit a zero-vector for empty input, but we changed it to emit an explicit "empty" tag in meta. maybe mismatch across deploys.
maria: noted. do we want SDK to enforce strict dim validation? current batcher silently returns mixed lengths which downstream reranker chokes on.
kev: prefer failing the batch with a descriptive error (e.g., "dim mismatch: expected 1536 got 0 for id X"). add an env flag EMBED_STRICT_DIMS=false to fallback to logging + skip.
jon: also add a metric counter embed.dim_mismatch and sample a few failing IDs to s3 for offline triage.
maria: implementing tests: unit for dim validation, integration that simulates truncated stream by returning incomplete json objects and ensuring decoder surfaces error. PR will include docs note.
devex-bot: heads up: DOC-412 opened: "embed SDK: dim validation guidance" assigned to devdocs.
ingest-bot: ingest job 2026-03-12-948 failed: 27 items with vec_len=0. See /var/log/ingest/948/failures.log
maria: thanks, tagging @kev for review once PR ready. will also include dev-mode that fills missing vecs with deterministic random vec so downstream latency stable for e2e tests.
kev: can review tomorrow morning. if prod is affected we can ship hotfix with EMBED_STRICT_DIMS=false and a temporary reingest.
jon: also check the retry wrapper: if retry reads partial JSON then seeks back to start, decoder state might be corrupt. test with unwrapped http.Body.
maria: i'll run those checks, re-run extractor on failed batch IDs, and post results. PR link when ready. closing loop, thanks :thumbsup:
